## Natural history notes

A medium-sized grasshopper characterized by its brown to tan coloration, slender body, long hind legs, and cryptic patterning that helps it blend into dry grasses and leaf litter. In Florida, it is found in open grassy habitats such as prairies, pine flatwoods, roadsides, fields, and disturbed areas where grasses and low vegetation are available. It feeds mainly on grasses and other herbaceous plants, usually resting low in vegetation or on the ground and jumping short distances when disturbed.
